'''OM-5''' was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], OM-5 and [[OM-7/Legends|OM-7]] were sent by their [[Unidentified OOM command battle droid (Ryloth)/Legends|Commander]] to check out a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Gunship]] that was blocking their path. OM-5 and OM-7 pulled the door open the gunship only to discover it was full of explosives. A [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] hidden in a nearby hill pressed the trigger,
which caused a huge explosion and destroyed OM-5 and OM-7.
